shared_elements: horizontal bands or rows of repeated signs
justification: The strongest correspondence is the use of schematic relief figures combined with horizontal bands of repeated geometric signs, with some birdlike/profile animal forms and curled serpent- or scroll-like elements. The major difference is that A is dominated by a single large central anthropomorphic or composite figure with flanking lower curls, while B is arranged as stacked registers of separate animals, heads, and signs rather than one central figure.
